reviews.review:
EDIT: OCTOBER 2023: As I predicted, new content a fixes molded this into a very decent game even considering 2023 standards of isometric games.  Graphics, game mechanics, and overall game-play is outdated by 5+ years.  But for $5 I think you'll enjoy the playing this game for a day or two.

ORIGINAL 2014 REVIEW: So, I bought this out of curiosity and initially it sucked balls.  However, with the new content updates, and bug fixes and developer road-map releases, I feel that the discounted price of $10 is very fair.  The discounted price will increase soon.  My suggestion is to purchase now while it's discounted due to EA status.
Its a great game and well worth getting it still gets content updates often and they just released a huge free DLC. and its got mechs and they are now adding customization to the player characters.

I don't know what, but something wrong with this shooter.
You have weapons, you have enemies, but no action, no interesting situations, interesting enemies.
I did run it few times, but maximum - 2 fights and game boring me(

After developer response I tried it once more.
All in all - the same. And found some bugs, like broken mission, character spawned in object after death.
After the mission 10 - not enought ammo on missions. For all classes.
Purple and blue loot dissappered very fast. In a battle no a time for looting, and some major loot dissappeared and it's sad.
The system sayed - new weapons, but no new weapons in the bench. It confused me.
I think icons 1 and 3 classes need change. The icon aim better for the sniper than just usual soldier. And just soldier will be better with the icon - 3 bullets.
1/3 missions causes bug - a camera move to a random point and thats all. It means need close the game throught alt+f4 wait some time and start again.
Mission 22 impossible even on easy level.

reviews.review: I liked the game very much. So far, everything is unclear, but very interesting.
Very fun game,has a lot of potential. the devs are updating it on a regular basis and adding new content/fixing bugs...costs less than a pack of smokes! what more can i say

Game looks pretty decent but there is one thing lacking and this is gamepad support.
The development team have made half an effort and some Gamepad interactions can be performed but still has its problems and therefore leave a unsatisfied desire to enjoy the game as its not completed functions cause issues.
I hope the development see this review as some much needed energy to complete what they have started going forward.
I recommend this as a pointer shooter but not as a gamepad twinstick....
